hypothesis: The current reducer path is a local pressure-expansion omission. CAESAR represents a reducer as ten successively changing pipe cylinders, and the saved BM4_NL job has Bourdon translational+rotational pressure effects enabled. The current LFEA ten-cylinder reducer condenser owns gravity and thermal strain but the ACCDB solver sets reducer pressureAxialStrain=0. Apply the same qualified closed-end pressure axial-strain law used by ordinary straight pipe to each of the ten reducer cylinders, sum their free axial extensions, and convert that total free extension through the already-condensed reducer stiffness. No coefficient is fitted.

authoritySources.authorityStatement: CAESAR models a concentric reducer as ten successively changing pipe cylinders over the reducer length.

authoritySources.authorityStatement: Bourdon pressure effects include axial elongation of straight pipe; the closed-end axial pressure strain is governed by the same material/diameter/wall/pressure/Poisson inputs used by the qualified straight-pipe implementation.

decisionReason: The exact-head real-ACCDB A/B validates reducer pressure-elongation ownership as a real local omission rather than a fitted response tweak. Adding the existing closed-end pressure strain law through the existing ten-cylinder reducer and Schur boundary resolves the entire L19 sources13-17 axial FX failure chain and cuts L19 source-action failures from 16 to 5 while also improving displacement/rotation failures from 67 to 57. No non-reducer pressure-strain ledger entry changes, 12/12 bend custody is preserved and target equilibrium remains within the locked tolerance. The mechanism does not complete the system: L19 still has node20090 FY and node21470 FY above 10%, and L20 remains incomplete with a small displacement-count regression. Therefore reducer pressure ownership is accepted as component mechanics, but no claim of M047 completion or production cutover is made.
acceptanceInterpretation: Promote the reducer pressure mechanism only if the real-data A/B improves the reducer/adjacent source-action field without breaking global equilibrium or materially degrading accepted smooth-90 fields.
Do not reject the local mechanism solely because unrelated node20090 remains above 10%; classify component correctness separately from final system completion.
Reject if the candidate relies on CAESAR target values, fitted pressure strain, changed reducer stiffness sampling, changed thermal strain or weakened tolerances.
